params.body:
An app can now say where its collector's adapters stand
(Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#185). This is the side that gives a silence its
weight.

Gentells' TikTok adapter returned nothing from 12 May and took Instagram and
Reddit search with it; every round logged "0 signals, 0 errors" for four months
and no layer said a word, because a collector that fetches nothing raises no
error.

## How overdue is measured

- Against each adapter's **own declared expectation** ("at least one per 7d"),
  with the half-again grace a late job already gets, so a weekly source is not
  called late on day eight.
- **Two witnesses, the later one wins**: the app's run history and its signals
  table. The run history is young and the sources that matter died before it
  began.
- An adapter neither witness has heard from is judged only once its history is
  older than its own grace. Absent stays absent until then; after that "never
  delivered" is a finding with that name.
- **Root causes only are counted.** A dependent of a dead upstream is named, with
  what it waits on, and kept out of the count. A count that doubles itself
  teaches people to halve it.

## Two facets

| facet | threshold | level |
|---|---|---|
| `collection` | `ADAPTERS_OVERDUE` | week: a dead source starves a product slowly, it is not a fire |
| `orphans` | `SOURCES_ORPHANED` | month: a row switched on that nothing collects harms nothing, it only says something untrue |

An app that reports no collection is not judged on it.

687 tests pass, 8 new. Pint and PHPStan clean.
params.title: Judge what an app collects, and whether it still does
